1:_: (Magen Avraham s.k. 4.) Thursday Friday — if so Monday is weekday and it is not applicable — thus it should read:
2:_: (Taz s.k. 5.) And I am astonished that it was hidden from him. — see: and I say that it was hidden from him the words of Tosafos in Eruvin daf 80 that if so from their eyes this mishnah was also hidden. But according to my humble opinion that mitzvot were not given for benefit — as Ra'osh wrote in chapter Kol HaMe'arvin siman 2 — see there:
3:_: (Rama seif 6.) And therefore they make lechi. — end of the matter Ra' Tam does not hold this law, for otherwise there is no question at all in Eruvin daf 11 s.v. ipkha; also Beit Yosef and Bach and Ritva brought these words of Tosafos and did not resolve in such a case — therefore do not be concerned for what he wishes to uphold the practice, and so I did according to the reasoning when I was in Prague in all places two lechayim in a wall structure from here and from there and a rope of iron on top so that it be tzurat hapetach that they not be damaged by winds and wagons, and the rabbis praised it:
4:_: (Magen Avraham s.k. 18) And if they are together with the airspace between them — thus it should read:
5:_: (Shulchan Aruch seif 24) And it extends somewhat below ten — it is valid. — see: it appears that for amplification they stated thus, meaning even if the korah extends within ten to the ground of the mavo and the qualification of korah must be below ten and it is recognizable that he did not place this korah for the sake of korah qualification but as partition that the korah is wide ten — it teaches us that nevertheless it is valid, and what enters from the korah within ten we view etc. And according to this assumption one need not emend Bach and Taz and Magen Avraham — see there:
6:_: (Taz s.k. 12.) And even though the law of lavud. — this wording is in Hagahot Maimoniyot according to the explanation of R' Meir that the korot themselves touch and they themselves must be a width of a tefach; but according to the other view that holds even distant — still the question remains: zil hakah leika shiyura and zil hakah leika shiyura; rather thus is the explanation: the other view holds that it must specifically receive a brick in its width and Rambam holds that even receiving a brick in its length:
7:_: (Taz s.k. 26.) It is an opening from one mavo to its fellow. — it cannot be reconciled, for if so every crooked mavo if open ten we would say it is an opening:
